## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new feature
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `refactor` — no observable behavior change
- [ ] `test` — tests only
- [ ] `chore` — build, CI, or tooling

## Checklist

- [ ] Code follows the clean-room methodology (no proprietary code inspected or copied)
- [ ] `cargo test --workspace` passes
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passes
- [ ] `pnpm --filter @pizzico/app-web build` succeeds
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change
- [ ] Documentation updated in `docs/` where relevant
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]`
- [ ] No new `unsafe` code without justification
